name: Anime line art
plain: Anime line art (a pix2pix U-Net, as packaged for ControlNet by lllyasviel): draws the clean outlines of an anime or cartoon image as a line map, the input of the anime line-art ControlNet. MIT code and weights.
summary: Anime line art preprocessor of ControlNet 1.1 (controlnet_aux `LineartAnimeDetector`, ComfyUI's "Anime Lineart"): a pix2pix U-Net (8 levels, instance norm, 54 M parameters) turns an anime-style image into a clean line drawing at a multiple of 256 px.

papers.title: Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks
Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

no_kernels_reason: a pix2pix U-Net: cuDNN convolutions and instance norm are the whole time; no custom kernel measured to pay off
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a line / edge map `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size (1 = line), the ControlNet preprocessors (line art, HED, PiDiNet, TEED / Anyline); M-LSD also returns straight line segments.

variants.name: lineart-anime

licence.training_note: Not stated for these checkpoints (lllyasviel/Annotators, ControlNet 1.1); ControlNet 1.1 describes the anime line art model as trained on anime illustrations and their line drawings.
notes: weights licence not stated by the original authors; assumed to be the code licence

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
